# Architecture Skill

Use this skill to derive a minimal MVP architecture from the approved requirements.

Procedure:
1. Read docs/requirements.md and identify in-scope constraints, functional requirements, and non-functional requirements.
2. Define the system boundary, key components, responsibilities, and interfaces.
3. Choose the simplest technology choices consistent with the MVP and the approved constraints.
4. Describe the end-to-end data flow and requirement-to-component coverage.
5. Validate the design against approved requirements and note unresolved risks or assumptions.
6. Stop for human approval before continuing to later phases.

Do not invent new requirements or silently change the approved requirement document.
